use_case_summary: Customer: product-oriented mid-market SaaS with in-app AI assistant (chat + contextual suggestions), search embeddings for docs, and a reranking pipeline for candidate responses. Requirements: maintain prompt parity with existing OpenAI-based outputs, p50 latency <= 120ms for short queries, p95 < 400ms, throughput ~40-60 req/s, strict audit logs and SSO, ability to migrate to Dedicated for predictable cost later. Cost sensitive to per-token pricing and caching/batching strategies.

migration_notes: Current provider: OpenAI (mix of gpt-4o and embeddings); strategy = Hosted → Dedicated migration path
Planned approach: run Hosted POC to verify prompt parity and regressions, build small compatibility shim to translate stop tokens and temp/penalty settings, run A/B test against baseline for 2 weeks
Key risks: subtle differences in tokenization, safety filter behavior, and sampling randomness leading to production regressions
Mitigations: canonical prompt suite, regression alerting tied to eval metrics, canary rollout with automatic fallback to source provider until Dedicated validated
